text_block_list.text:
In the hallway, I saw Mihono Bourbon
standing there in a daze.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I am deeply sorry... Due to cognitive decline, Master recognition... failed... f-fa...il.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
The cause... appears to be... severe fatigue
from the strain of racing... I... believe...

Fatigue from the race is starting to affect her daily life.
It would be wise to reconsider her race schedule...
